I'll use the standard ALS concept (373182) and its descendants. Let me build the ALS cohort using the earliest ALS diagnosis as the index date, then look at events across domains in the following 12 months. First, let me establish the cohort and check data availability.

arguments.sql_query:
WITH als_concepts AS (
  SELECT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 373182
),
als_index AS (
  SELECT co.person_id, MIN(co.condition_start_date) AS index_date
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  WHERE co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM als_concepts)
  GROUP BY co.person_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS als_patients,
       MIN(index_date) AS earliest_dx,
       MAX(index_date) AS latest_dx
FROM als_index;

3,626 ALS patients. Now let me analyze the most frequent health events by category (OMOP domain) within 12 months after ALS diagnosis, and separately identify the mechanical ventilation cohort to assess impact. Let me run these in parallel.

arguments.sql_query:
WITH als_concepts AS (
  SELECT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 373182
),
als_index AS (
  SELECT co.person_id, MIN(co.condition_start_date) AS index_date
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  WHERE co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM als_concepts)
  GROUP BY co.person_id
),
events AS (
  -- Conditions
  SELECT 'Condition' AS category, c.condition_concept_id AS concept_id, e.person_id
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence c JOIN als_index e ON c.person_id=e.person_id
  WHERE c.condition_start_date > e.index_date
    AND c.condition_start_date <= DATEADD(month,12,e.index_date)
    AND c.condition_concept_id <> 0
    AND c.condition_concept_id NOT IN (SELECT concept_id FROM als_concepts)
  UNION ALL
  -- Procedures
  SELECT 'Procedure', p.procedure_concept_id, e.person_id
  FROM omop.procedure_occurrence p JOIN als_index e ON p.person_id=e.person_id
  WHERE p.procedure_date > e.index_date AND p.procedure_date <= DATEADD(month,12,e.index_date) AND p.procedure_concept_id<>0
  UNION ALL
  -- Drugs
  SELECT 'Drug', d.drug_concept_id, e.person_id
  FROM omop.drug_exposure d JOIN als_index e ON d.person_id=e.person_id
  WHERE d.drug_exposure_start_date > e.index_date AND d.drug_exposure_start_date <= DATEADD(month,12,e.index_date) AND d.drug_concept_id<>0
  UNION ALL
  -- Measurements
  SELECT 'Measurement', m.measurement_concept_id, e.person_id
  FROM omop.measurement m JOIN als_index e ON m.person_id=e.person_id
  WHERE m.measurement_date > e.index_date AND m.measurement_date <= DATEADD(month,12,e.index_date) AND m.measurement_concept_id<>0
  UNION ALL
  -- Observations
  SELECT 'Observation', o.observation_concept_id, e.person_id
  FROM omop.observation o JOIN als_index e ON o.person_id=e.person_id
  WHERE o.observation_date > e.index_date AND o.observation_date <= DATEADD(month,12,e.index_date) AND o.observation_concept_id<>0
)
SELECT category,
       COUNT(*) AS total_event_rows,
       COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS patients_with_any
FROM events
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY patients_with_any DESC;

I'll define a broad ventilation concept set (invasive MV, NIV/BiPAP/CPAP, tracheostomy for airway, ventilator dependence, home ventilator devices) using descendants, then build the "ever ventilated" flag and compare event rates. Let me get the top specific events per category alongside building the ventilation cohort.

arguments.sql_query:
WITH als_concepts AS (
  SELECT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 373182
),
als_index AS (
  SELECT co.person_id, MIN(co.condition_start_date) AS index_date
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  WHERE co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM als_concepts)
  GROUP BY co.person_id
),
-- ventilation-related standard concepts via ancestors of key roots
vent_concepts AS (
  SELECT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (
    37158404, -- Invasive mechanical ventilation
    4177224,  -- Artificial ventilation (broad, if exists)
    37152361, -- Bilevel artificial ventilation
    4165535,  -- CPAP treatment
    40481547, -- Dependence on ventilator (condition)
    46273524, -- Dependence on home ventilator
    4337047,  -- Insertion of tracheostomy tube
    1073322   -- Construction of tracheostomy
  )
),
vent_persons AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.person_id
  FROM als_index e
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM omop.procedure_occurrence p
                WHERE p.person_id=e.person_id AND p.procedure_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM vent_concepts))
     OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM omop.condition_occurrence c
                WHERE c.person_id=e.person_id AND c.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM vent_concepts))
     OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM omop.device_exposure d
                WHERE d.person_id=e.person_id AND d.device_concept_id IN (915608,915609,1128078,953197,40493026,45758195,45759002,45771119))
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM als_index) AS total_als,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vent_persons) AS ever_ventilated;

Let me capture the vent cohort into detail and run the two core analyses: (1) top specific events per category within 12 months post-diagnosis, and (2) comparison of event category frequency between ventilated vs non-ventilated patients. Let me get the top named events per category.

arguments.sql_query:
WITH als_concepts AS (
  SELECT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id=373182
),
als_index AS (
  SELECT co.person_id, MIN(co.condition_start_date) AS index_date
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  WHERE co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM als_concepts)
  GROUP BY co.person_id
),
ev AS (
  SELECT 'Condition' cat, c.condition_concept_id cid, e.person_id
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence c JOIN als_index e ON c.person_id=e.person_id
  WHERE c.condition_start_date>e.index_date AND c.condition_start_date<=DATEADD(month,12,e.index_date)
    AND c.condition_concept_id<>0 AND c.condition_concept_id NOT IN (SELECT concept_id FROM als_concepts)
),
r AS (
  SELECT cat, cid, COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) pts
  FROM ev GROUP BY cat, cid
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT cat, cid, pts, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cat ORDER BY pts DESC) rn FROM r
)
SELECT ranked.cat, c.concept_name, ranked.pts,
  CAST(100.0*ranked.pts/(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM als_index) AS DECIMAL(5,1)) pct_of_als
FROM ranked JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id=ranked.cid
WHERE ranked.rn<=15 ORDER BY ranked.cat, ranked.pts DESC;
